Thanks everyone for a productive session this morning. Below is a short recap and action log while items are fresh. Attaching the session artifacts (kickoff-photos.zip) and a versioned runbook we updated live.

Recap (Thu 11/26 09:30–12:00 PT):
- Access: All engineers validated access to the sandbox; role-based tokens issued.
- Prompt review: Tuned multi-prompt flow A -> reduced hallucination by adjusting system prompt and adding a post-filter step.
- Routing: Marcus ran failure-injection scenarios; we observed automatic fallback to the cost-tier model with 200ms extra latency under simulated node loss.
- Load test dry run: Traffic generator ran 20k reqs over 10m; observed 95th p50 latency ~210ms with caching on and 310ms with caching off.

Action items (owner — due):
1) Marissa: Export the session logs and upload to shared Drive (due 2026-11-27 EOD).
2) Marcus: Finalize failure-injection script and push to the repo (JIRA-REDWOOD-512) (due 2026-11-30).
3) Dev: Update the load test plan with the Veridian traffic mix (sheet: traffic_mix) and run a full 1-hour test next week (due 2026-12-03).
4) Soojin: Produce a short technical recap for Veridian leadership and propose dates for Sprint 2 (due 2026-11-29).

Next steps:
- Proposed Sprint 2 window: the week of 12/7. I will send a Doodle this afternoon; please flag blackout dates.
- We recommend a 2-hour Sprint 2 focused on long-run load tests and quantization profiles for cost optimization.

Thanks again — felt like a solid first working session.

Best,
Soojin
